**Status: frozen design cases; R03 qualified.** `cases.json` retains 25 IDs for managed revision provenance, role grants, exact binding, fake-clock freshness and deadlines, durable replay, stop recovery, operation ownership, and every current private-socket bypass. Each row names its minimum evidence level. The [first-use evidence](../../../docs/eos/design/runtime/admission-revision-guide.md#first-use-replay) lists reproducible replay steps and verification commands; changing an expected result still requires owner-contract and independent design review. Run `python3 tests/fixtures/r03_admission_revision/check_cases.py` to verify the table and contract anchors. Reviewed EOS and IsOS implementations merged, and the post-merge clean-home mock-base replay qualified grant issuance, launch handoff, and governed gRPC behavior; its output is in the primary IsOS checkout at `data/test/20261102-r03-cross-repo/post-merge-primary.log`. R05/R06 still own physical MuJoCo fencing and stop/reap proof.
